content: A configured 3840x2160 at 60 Hz session is not proof of sustained 4K60. Acceptance must count captured, encoded, received, decoded, and presented frames under continuous motion, record drops and frame pacing, and measure queue and stage latency over a fixed run after warm-up. At 60 fps the frame interval is 16.67 ms; Parsec treats encode or decode near that duration as unable to sustain 60 fps, while Moonlight expects queue latency below one frame interval and network drops near zero. Exact end-to-end thresholds are project acceptance budgets rather than ecosystem facts. Sources: https://support.parsec.app/hc/en-us/articles/32381352822804-Troubleshooting-Lag-Latency-and-Quality-Issues and https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-docs/wiki/Frequently-Asked-Questions.
